case_name: Jagpal Singh vs Chairman Administrative Committee Up ...
author: Uday Umesh Lalit

paragraphs.text:
CHAIRMAN ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE
 U.P. MILK UNION & DAIRY FEDERATION
 CENTRALIZED SERVICES …Respondent

Court found that the order of punishment passed by the Administrative
incorrect, the Appeal was allowed by this Court.
The grounds raised in the Review Petition do not make out any error

apparent on record to justify interference in Review Jurisdiction.
This Review Petition is, therefore, dismissed.

application is devoid of merit and is, therefore, dismissed.
…………………………..J.
 [Uday Umesh Lalit]
